entries.en: Rancour; to bear a grudge; to hold resentment.
Accumulated grudge; long-nursed resentment.
Accumulated resentment; stored-up grievance.
To harbour resentment; to nurse a grievance.
entries.notes: H 栏作「會」，与 R 栏对音 ham（含/銜）不合，疑为「含」之形讹；M 栏作「怨」，故定为含怨。

entries.en: To harbour anger; to nurse indignation.
Malice; spiteful conduct.
entries.notes: 「毒行」非习见词，据 H「毒」、M「行」及西语词头 rencor 推为狠毒之行，词义存疑。

entries.zh: 怨；置恨，把怨恨积存心中。
entries.en: Resentment; to lay up a grudge.
Envy; jealous resentment.
entries.notes: R 栏「guu」与「嫉」常读不合，M 栏作「恨」，末附西语 embidia（envidia）；据该夹注定为嫉妒义，读音存疑。

entries.en: To cherish a grudge; to hold resentment.
entries.notes: 汉栏三证（懷/恨/huay hun）一致；R 栏末「gle hino supresado」为污损旁注，难辨其意。

entries.zh: 切恨袂化——恨意深切，无法化解。
entries.en: Great rancour that cannot be dissolved.
entries.notes: M 栏「花」当为「化」之借字（R 作 hua），与 L 栏「y no seguira」（不复延续）相合。

entries.zh: 恨深似海——极言仇恨之深。
entries.en: Hatred deep as the sea; boundless rancour.
Deep hatred; profound rancour.

entries.zh: 充天恨——恨意充塞天地，极言仇恨之大。
entries.en: Hatred filling the heavens; immeasurable rancour.
entries.notes: R 栏「ty」对应「天」（thiⁿ），M 栏亦作「天恨」，与 H「充」合为「充天恨」；末「iss.」为 grandissimo 之缩写。

entries.en: To submit; to yield.
entries.notes: M 栏[空]、L 次词残缺（疑 reconciliarse）、R 首词「suftao」污损难辨（疑「輸服/投服」类写音）；仅据 H「服」与 R 末「hog」定屈服义。

entries.en: To surrender; to submit; to yield.

entries.zh: 制服人，以强力使人屈服。
entries.en: To subdue someone by force; to force submission.
Line; row (of writing).
Row; line; order of arrangement.
Row; line.
entries.notes: R 栏「quy」与「行」常读不合（T99 污损），M 栏[空]；释义依 L renglón 与 H「行」定，读音存疑。

entries.zh: 成行，排列成行（原件删改残缺，释义存疑）。
entries.en: To form rows; to draw up in line (reading deleted and defective).
entries.notes: R 栏有删除线（liey chia quy）、M 栏「行[残]」、L 栏「renflon orden ello.」系 renglón 讹写，仅 H「成」可据，无法定夺。
